boss-portrait.name: Boss portraits & synthwave posters
boss-portrait.workflow: Select a specific subject and attitude -> reference-guided monumental portrait/ensemble -> silhouette and identity QA -> typeset title separately -> bounded light/reveal choreography.
boss-portrait.constraint: Near-black ground, hard violet/cyan rim light, pixel texture; selectively, never a neon philosopher for every concept.

cinematic-metaphor.name: Cinematic / mythic visual metaphors
cinematic-metaphor.workflow: Literalize the relationship in one scene -> choose character action and focal point -> cinematic high-contrast art -> purposeful reveal at the spoken pivot.
cinematic-metaphor.constraint: Concrete dramatic situation and opposing forces; avoid generic soft-painted sepia and arbitrary drift.

comic-satire.name: Comic / retro-ad satire
comic-satire.workflow: Identify one comic contradiction -> storyboard punchline -> bold illustration without text -> typeset exact wording separately -> reveal at the joke/claim.
comic-satire.constraint: Graphic silhouettes, halftone, oversized objects and an absurd physical metaphor.

meme-remix.name: Meme & pop-culture remix
meme-remix.workflow: Source recognizable original -> verify context and rights -> crop/composite and typeset -> reveal setup/payoff; generate only a missing transformation.
meme-remix.constraint: A real original is required; recreated material must be distinguishable. Reference not redistributed because third-party rights are unconfirmed.

reference.title: Free Thinker
reference.rights: Not packaged; third-party rights/context must be checked

explanatory-mechanism.name: Explanatory diagrams & visual mechanisms
explanatory-mechanism.workflow: Write causal relationship -> select component -> editable SVG/HTML -> map state changes to locked spoken words -> render and phone QA.
explanatory-mechanism.constraint: Use Module B, not a raster-generated diagram; relationships must change and explain.

source-evidence.name: Receipts, quotations & documentary evidence
source-evidence.workflow: Retrieve original -> verify quotation/numbers -> crop/highlight/reframe -> animate attention, never evidence.
source-evidence.constraint: Authentic sources only. Never generate papers, charts, screenshots or quotes. Third-party source thumbnail is not redistributed.

reference.title: Stanford Prison Experiment
reference.rights: Not packaged; third-party rights/context must be checked

episode-identity.name: Episode identity & host composites
episode-identity.workflow: Same-episode verified host stills -> established black/gold or neon composite treatment -> separate accurate typography -> restrained title/end transition.
episode-identity.constraint: Identity is not explanatory B-roll. Do not generate host identities from a generic style reference.
